evidence: Frozen workbook Quality Checks!A26:D26 and Internal Quality Checks!A26:D26 require every dimension prompt to drive the browser. All five frozen prompt.md files explicitly direct evaluation of http://localhost:3000 using Playwright MCP at line 1 (Render and Constraints continue at line 2); each corresponding judge.toml declares playwright-mcp at lines 8-12, and tests/test.sh:195-200 substitutes app_context before RewardKit runs the suites. Render judge.toml:23-27 requires an authored computed sum in preview and console, so a static first paint or copied source cannot pass. Constraints judge.toml:23-29 requires a fresh UI save and server readback from an independent clean browser context, so a localStorage-only library or static health response cannot pass. Functional prompt.md:5-25 requires reload, UI actions and positive controls; Polish prompt.md:13-49 requires a keyboard navigation tour; Visual prompt.md:31-55 requires rendered desktop/mobile review. Each forbids submitted implementation as scoring evidence. A conforming server-rendered library with no JSON endpoint, an initially empty library, and nonstandard usable labels remain eligible under Constraints prompt.md:15-33 and Visual prompt.md:31-43. Evidence/25/source-audit.json verifies all ten prompt/judge files match frozen manifest hashes and all five prompt/browser wiring checks; all 77 raw-index artifacts matched their current hashes. The raw index and local-proof-summary describe scripted golden browser runs, not configured judge behavior; no exact-current configured judge transcript or timing result establishes actual tool use. Source-level row requirement passes, while that runtime gap remains a risk.
